item.title: Quinta Brunson to receive GLAAD award for being ally to the LGBTQ+ community
item.description: 'Abbott Elementary' showrunner Quinta Brunson will receive GLAAD's Vanguard Award, which is given to stars who don't identify as LGBTQ+ but have made a difference in promoting acceptance of queer people and issues.

item.title: Wrexham AFC, the soccer club co-owned by Rob Mac, returns to Philly region this summer
item.description: Welsh soccer club Wrexham AFC is coming to the Philly region for a game against the Premier League's Sunderland AFC on Aug. 2. The club is owned by Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds, and has been rising up the ranks of English football.

item.title: ABBA-themed dance party coming to South Philly’s American Swedish Historical Museum
item.description: The March 21 'ExtrABBAganza' event will feature disco hits, drag performances and a retro-themed dance floor.

item.title: The Wardrobe to host free clothing events across the Philly region to address clothing insecurity
item.description: The Wardrobe will host two free events in March as part of Women’s History Month, including clothing giveaways across the Philadelphia region and a panel discussion with women working in the fashion industry.

item.title: Women's pain often lasts longer than men's — that's not just a perception
item.description: Men's bodies are able to shut down pain more quickly than women's due to higher levels of testosterone and other sex hormones, new research suggests. The study confirms that women's pain isn't all in their heads.

item.title: Metropolitan Bakery to close Rittenhouse location this month after over 32 years in business
item.description: Metropolitan Bakery will close its Rittenhouse location at 262 S. 19th St. on March 15 after over 32 years in business. The shop’s brand and recipes were sold to Merzbacher's in Germantown, which will continue to sell its products.

item.title: SEPTA gets $5.5 million in federal funding to enhance World Cup service
item.description: As SEPTA gets ready for the World Cup this summer, it is getting $5.5 million in federal funding to increase and improve service. SEPTA plans to add a shuttle to the FIFA FanFest in Lemon Hill and more Broad Street Line subways to games at Lincoln Financial Field.

item.title: N.J. Turnpike Authority testing a sticker alternative to E-ZPass transponders
item.description: The New Jersey Turnpike Authority will begin testing an alternative to the E-ZPass transponder on its fleet vehicles. If it goes well, the state could introduce the stickers to all customers. Massachusetts has already made the switch.

item.title: Instant observations: Jabari Walker saves Sixers vs. tanking Jazz
item.description: The Utah Jazz sat two starting frontcourts worth of players on Wednesday night. But playing without four starters themselves, the Sixers bungled a chance to notch a stress-free win on Wednesday.

item.title: Sarah J. Maas announces release dates for next 2 books in 'ACOTAR' series
item.description: Sarah J. Maas, a former resident of Bucks County, shared the release dates for two upcoming books in her popular 'A Court of Thorns and Roses' series on Wednesday's episode of Call Her Daddy.
